caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top that has rounded ends and drop-leaf sides, rendered in shades of reddish-brown. The wood grain is visible across the surface, with light reflections adding dimension. Four slender, turned legs support the table, each leg ending in a simple rounded foot. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or textures, creating contrast and focus on the table itself. There is a faint shadow cast beneath the table, indicating a light source from above. The edges and contours of the table are clearly defined, with the reflection of light giving the impression of a polished finish.
title: Table
